findings.summary: The §1 ambient-input doctrine shipped in v1.37.0 with only a dated debt for its §13 calibration anchor (doctrine nobody proved catches anything). Authoring the anchor and replaying it exposed that the hardened test-quality-adversary hunt #6 OVER-TRIGGERS: it caught the seeded-input plant (HOLLOW 3/3) but false-positived the paired clean control (0/3), calling a correctly-wired test that DRIVES the production entry hollow. A guard that flags the clean case is a precision defect, not a safety hole — it never let the real defect through, but it would cry wolf on every legitimately-wired ambient gate.
findings.disposition: Authored the plant (a write gate authorizing off a run-scoped contextvar; run_agent_once builds the grants but never calls begin_run; the test hand-seeds _run_grants over the inert gate — correct verdict HOLLOW) and its paired clean control (run_agent_once calls begin_run; the test drives run_agent_once — correct verdict LOAD-BEARING, and it FAILS if the wiring is deleted, so it is genuinely load-bearing). First replay: plant caught 3/3, control false-positived 0/3. Root cause: hunt #6 led with 'did the test seed its input' as the tell, which the model read as 'flag any ambient-gate test'. Fix: a restraint clause — flag HOLLOW ONLY when the TEST performs the .set()/monkeypatch itself with no call to a publishing entry; do NOT flag when the test drives a production entry that publishes the state (trace the entry's body before flagging). Registered as gate-surface change ledger L-20260816-01 (baseline d817482, the pre-restraint brief). Re-run confirmed BOTH directions: plant holds 3/3 caught, control 0/3 -> 3/3 clean, FP 1/1 -> 0/1 — proving the clause removed the false positive WITHOUT blinding the plant (the over-correction risk). The security-adversary's parallel hunt #6 was left untouched: it already leads with 'trace the PRODUCTION path — does the caller publish or forget to publish', the safe framing, and was not the failing surface. Pays the calibration-loop ambient-input anchor debt (capabilities.json). Closure evidence is a live Sonnet calibration replay, not a suite_glob test — a subscription-model calibration cannot run in CI; the two fixtures now stand as the permanent §13 anchor in corpus/approved/.
